title: Chapter 256 Are You Worthy Of It?
content:
Chapter 256 Are You Worthy Of It?

The thunder tribulation is getting bigger and bigger, and its destructive power is also increasing at a rapid rate.

But Emperor Yuan still stood tall and proudly in the void.

In this way, until the seventh thunder tribulation, Emperor Yuan was moved.

I saw that the originally dark void suddenly showed a strange aura.

Shocking thunder catastrophe!

Emperor Yuan clasped his palms together, and a huge golden phantom slowly emerged from his body.

"The incarnation of Jin Yuan!"

Buzz —

In an instant, the entire void was filled with dazzling golden light.

The people in the Golden Immortal World looked at the huge golden phantom in the void, and their expressions were filled with endless worship.

I haven't seen Emperor Yuan use this move for many years.

Because this move is not a trick with strong destructive power, but a simple defensive move.

The Yuan Emperor's skill in becoming famous at that time was the ten thousand lights.

It is known as the most terrifying killing move in the Immortal Emperor's territory in history.

Now, this move of Jinyuan incarnation is enough to be called the hardest defensive move.

However, since Emperor Yuan rose, he has rarely used this trick.

Because no one is qualified to defend him, he is the only one who can beat others.

Just when the world was worshipping it, the terrifying cloud of disaster suddenly burst out the thunder disaster in an inappropriate manner.

boom!

A deafening roar sounded.

I saw a huge black thunder catastrophe surged out from the catastrophe clouds.

At the same time, the entire void where Emperor Yuan was also completely shattered, presenting a piece of nothingness.

Black thunder tribulation!

Rumble!

The black terrifying thunder tribulation continued to surge out of the catastrophe clouds, slashing directly onto the Yuan Emperor's Jinyuan incarnation.

It can be seen from the naked eye that the Jin Yuan incarnation begins to appear dense cracks.

Seeing this, the world suddenly felt cold sweat.

I don’t know how long it took, the black thunder tribulation slowly dissipated.

The seventh thunder tribulation ends.

"Huh~ It's okay."

The world just breathed a sigh of relief.

The same was true for Emperor Yuan who was in the void, but immediately, Emperor Yuan's face changed drastically.

"What!"

boom!

A golden light that was even more dazzling than the incarnation of the Golden Yuan surged out from the disaster clouds, instantly illuminating the entire Golden Immortal Realm into a golden ocean.

I saw a golden thunder tribulation turning into a hideous thunder dragon rushing out of the catastrophe cloud, roaring at the Yuan Emperor in the void.

Thunder tribulation transforms!

Bang!

Jin Yuan's incarnation completely shattered under the tear-up of the thunder dragon transformed by the catastrophe cloud.

Emperor Yuan also had black hair dispersed, his eyes were blood red, and blood slowly overflowed from the corners of his mouth, obviously suffering considerable injuries.

At this moment, the atmosphere in the entire Golden Immortal Realm became extremely depressing.

"Return, is there any?"

I don't know who muttered this.

But the rest of the people dared not happen.

This thunder tribulation was already extremely terrifying, almost beyond their predictions.

There are not many records about the peak tribulation of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

I thought the seven thunder tribulations were already terrifying.

There is actually the eighth way, and it has reached the terrifying transformation level.

Even Emperor Yuan, who is known as the invincible player of the Immortal Emperor Realm, suffered considerable injuries.

So is there a ninth way?

This question briefly filled everyone's hearts, but the next moment it disappeared.

I saw that the terrifying disaster cloud suddenly emitted a blood-red light in the direction above Emperor Yuan’s head.

Seeing this scene, Emperor Yuan's body tensed, his fists clenched, and he stared at the catastrophe clouds above the void.

A breath of death lingered around him.

God is going to destroy him? !

It seems that the legend is true. Above the Immortal Emperor, it is really not something that this world can tolerate.

At this moment, as long as he restrains his breath and then explodes his cultivation level, he will no longer have to overcome this thunder tribulation.

But the price is that you will never be able to break through to the Immortal Emperor in this life.

After a moment of silence, Emperor Yuan suddenly grinned.

"I will do it if the heaven goes by, and I will do it if the heaven goes against it!"

Once upon a time, he was lucky and unhindered, and he was a perfect son of destiny.

But now, he has grown to the peak of the world.

The way of heaven no longer tolerate him.

But, so what? Nothing can stop him from pursuing power, even the way of heaven cannot do it.

Suddenly, Emperor Yuan's aura suddenly began to surge.

A stream of forces that did not belong to Emperor Yuan were constantly condensed from Emperor Yuan’s hands.

At this moment, the entire Golden Immortal World was in full bloom.

The name of Emperor Yuan began to roar in the world.

The sound was so loud that it even reached the distant fairyland.

"kill!"

A ferocious voice suddenly sounded from the disaster cloud.

Emperor Yuan looked around and saw that the blood-red catastrophe cloud turned into a brilliant blood-red hall at some time!

And the sound of killing came from the mouth of the blood-red figure standing in front of the hall.

"Bloody thunder tribulation!"

An extremely old roar suddenly sounded from the corner of the Golden Immortal Realm.

There was a strong sense of horror in his tone.

When people hear this, they are afraid of it.

Destroy the world!

At this moment when everyone was afraid, Emperor Yuan, who was in the most dangerous place, had no expression on his face.

"Destroy the world?"

"Can you destroy me?!"

There was a bang.

Emperor Yuan suddenly soared forward again and took the initiative to attack.

"kill!"

A sound full of killing came from the mouth of the figure in front of the hall again.

Immediately afterwards, the figure of the blood-red thunder tribulation rushed out of the robbery cloud and directly rushed towards Emperor Yuan.

......

The Jinyuan era of the Golden Immortal Realm has come to an end.

Under the shattering of the red thunder tribulation like the world, the entire era came to a perfect end.

The Golden Immortal Realm finally welcomed its first strong man above the Immortal Emperor Realm.

But in the end, no one knows where Emperor Yuan went.

.........

At the same time, in a bloody galaxy.

The smell of blood is everywhere.

Countless limbs that were still emitting a terrifying aura floated freely from the starry sky.

The whole starry sky was extremely quiet, but the atmosphere was extremely strange.

I saw a man in a mysterious robe sitting cross-legged in the starry sky, his eyes calmly.

His whole body was spotless, which contrasted with the bloody starry sky around him.

"Do you still want to continue?"

A cold voice suddenly sounded from his mouth.

Lu Daosheng looked at the starry sky in front of him, his eyes circling.

Not long ago, a great war just happened here. No, it was not so much a war, but rather a one-sided crush.

A comprehensive crush from Lu Daosheng, a hunched film.

But for some reason, Lu Daosheng stopped and did not kill him, but sat in the starry sky.

But even though Lu Daosheng did nothing, the enemy outside the domain never dared to show up again.

"The person who touched your scales is dead, what else do you want?"

The hoarse voice sounded from the depths of the galaxy, only the sound was heard, but no one was seen.

There was a hint of anger and helplessness in his tone.

"What else do you want?"

Hearing this, a sneer appeared from the corner of Lu Daosheng's mouth.

"I want to kill you and the whole clan to vent my anger."

As soon as these words came out, the entire silent galaxy was cheered up!

These words were extremely arrogant, but there was no reaction across the Galaxy.

"You will just be defeated by the death."

The sound came again.

But Lu Daosheng smiled disdainfully.

"You guys deserve it too!"

If Lu Daosheng hadn't suddenly thought of something, and had killed so many people, Lu Daosheng would never have stopped so easily.

This enemy outside the territory is not useless.
